27-inch display, slim black bezel, silver aluminum pedestal. User explicitly requests this product silhouette.
Compact 60-key keyboard; no separate numpad or function row. User explicitly requests Happy Hacking.
Inspected supplied floor lamp photograph: long silver articulated arm reaching left, tapered ivory fabric shade, narrow vertical stem and roundbase. Generated transparent asset; original not bundled.
Aeron mesh profile and graphite/polished-aluminum material combination.

decisions.adopt: User-approved frontal single window wall; outward-facing walnut desk; set camera back to show adjacent lounge, shelves and open Milky floor. No board.
